name: @fixora/desktop
//type: Deliberately NOT type:module. A sandboxed preload (sandbox: true, Security section 2) must be CommonJS — Electron does not support an ESM preload in a sandboxed renderer. The renderer itself is still ESM; Vite handles it.

scripts.package:win: pnpm --filter @fixora/core-analysis build && pnpm clean && electron-vite build && node scripts/prepackage.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/postpackage.mjs
scripts.release: pnpm --filter @fixora/core-analysis build && pnpm clean && electron-vite build && node scripts/prepackage.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish always && node scripts/postpackage.mjs
scripts.package:dir: pnpm --filter @fixora/core-analysis build && pnpm clean && electron-vite build && node scripts/prepackage.mjs && electron-builder --dir --win --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/postpackage.mjs

//dependencies: Only @fixora/core-analysis is a RUNTIME dependency: the ESM analysis worker imports it from disk (out/main/analysis-worker.mjs) so it can resolve tree-sitter WASM via import.meta.url. Every other @fixora/* package is bundled into the CJS main and the renderer by electron-vite, which makes them build-time inputs — they belong in devDependencies. Keeping them here also broke packaging: electron-builder's production-dependency walker follows pnpm's workspace symlinks out to packages/*, then refuses the realpath for being outside apps/desktop.
author: Fixora
